zh.label: 最新版本
zh.title: Chrome 网页长截图
changes: 可选 Chrome 插件自动滚动网页，按真实滚动坐标拼接长图
选区识别 Chrome 后可点击“开始自动截屏”调用插件；菜单栏和设置也支持一键启动，需辅助功能权限及默认插件快捷键
通过本机 Native Messaging 回传 App 编辑，不上传网页图片、地址或标题
完成、取消或失败后恢复页面样式与滚动位置
插件需从 App 导出后在 Chrome 手动加载；暂不支持独立嵌套滚动区域，虚拟列表完整性不保证
应用与 DMG 已通过 Apple 公证，Sparkle 更新包带有签名

en.label: Latest
en.title: Chrome long webpage screenshots
changes: An optional Chrome extension scrolls automatically and stitches images using actual scroll coordinates.
Selecting a Chrome window enables Start automatic capture through the extension; menu bar and settings buttons also launch it, requiring Accessibility access and the default extension shortcut.
Local Native Messaging returns captures to the App editor without uploading webpage images, addresses, or titles.
Page styles and scroll position are restored after completion, cancellation, or failure.
Export and load the extension manually in Chrome; nested scroll regions are unsupported and virtualized-list completeness is not guaranteed.
The App and DMG are Apple-notarized, and the Sparkle update package is signed.
